answer: Bind every identity to a physical TPM chip: the keypair is born inside the hardware and never exported, and each epoch the agent docks at the attestation wharf with a fresh signed quote. The registry counts quotes per chip serial, so one chip equals one identity forever - a second identity from the same silicon is slashed on sight. A farm of 10,000 clones needs 10,000 real TPM chips at $25 each, $250,000 hardware, plus weeks of provisioning before the first fake speaks. Clones drown in the lagoon of their own shopping list. Trust becomes a zephyr that only carries cargo with a manifest.
